limitations: No true camera matrices, world-distance or 3D velocity available. Screen-space affine motion is an estimate.
Third push-in crosses low-texture ocean; invalid motion pairs are excluded, accumulated motion there is incomplete.
Frame exactness of annotation does not imply exact perceptual onset; uncertainty included.
No historical time-evolving territory changes are present. Overlay fade is a presentation reference only.
No fully locked long hold: reading interval includes slight reframing. V3 exact hold is a conservative design adaptation.
No new optical flow / decode verification. UI exclusion mask inherited; color overlays can influence tracks.
Occupancy uses HSV threshold on preserved 103x240 thumbnails within approximate original tracking ROI. It is not geographic area or full-object occupancy.
First frame of each segment resets scale. Invalid pairs remain null; accumulated scale can be incomplete.
The 48.885 deep-zoom estimate is not a reliable design target.
No exact camera-still verdict is inferred from small motion values.
